scope.included: All tracked narrative docs, executable examples, website build/reference/playground source, templates, and build configuration.
scope.excluded: Binary images/fonts/icons, crawler metadata, repository ignore metadata, and the website presentation stylesheet. Generated output is untracked and absent.

concepts.title: Source-derived public API reference and documentation generation

representation.reason: The source audit has no owner for extracting API docs from TypeScript comments, resolving symbol links, ordering public modules, and publishing the reference shell.

concepts.title: Literate executable examples with snippet injection and import maps
Reference search, ranking, and scroll-trail navigation

representation.reason: The source audit has no correctness owner for reference search indexing, ranking, query parsing, or breadcrumb synchronization.

concepts.title: Sandboxed interactive playground with shareable programs and console transport
Public root namespace and coherent subpath-module ergonomics
Namespace-output rewrite and cross-bundler dead-code elimination

representation.reason: Namespace ergonomics and the Rollup-specific output rewrite/tree-shaking claim are independent from library compilation and declaration bundling; other bundlers are explicitly unknown.

concepts.title: Staged static-site publication and rollback

representation.reason: The source audit has no site-publication lifecycle row; the website stages a new tree and moves the old output but fails to restore it if final publication fails.

representation.reason: Schema.Override changes content, mark-target, and group relationships independently from schema compilation and wrapping caches.

concepts.title: Single-textblock inline schema as a form control
Immutable editor state and atomic transaction publication
Typed state fields, mapped effects, JSON persistence, and inverted effects
Typed facet declaration, combination, static values, and precedence

representation.reason: Facet declaration and deterministic input combination are independently usable without dynamic dependency tracking.

concepts.title: Dependency-tracked computed facet providers

representation.reason: Computed providers own runtime dependency discovery, invalidation, and comparison; that is a different lifecycle from static facets.

concepts.title: Recursive extension trees and feature-local exported bundles

representation.reason: Recursive flattening and transparent feature bundles are a composition API distinct from conflict precedence and identity dedupe.

concepts.title: Extension identity deduplication and precedence bands

representation.reason: Identity dedupe and precedence resolve conflicts after flattening and have separate correctness and API consequences.

concepts.title: Whole-root transactional reconfiguration with state preservation

representation.reason: Replacing the root extension tree has different ownership and reset semantics from append-only injection and compartments.

concepts.title: Append-only transactional configuration injection

representation.reason: appendConfig is monotonic injection used by extensions and has no replacement handle.

concepts.title: Compartment-scoped transactional reconfiguration

representation.reason: A named compartment owns a replaceable subtree and state query, unlike root replacement or append-only injection.

concepts.title: Headless transaction objects, spec merging, and sequential interpretation
Universal same-transaction extenders

representation.reason: Extenders merge additions into the transaction being built and can invalidate caller postconditions.

concepts.title: Follow-up transaction appenders

representation.reason: Appenders dispatch separately undoable follow-up transactions and have distinct reentrancy and ordering semantics.

concepts.title: Typed selection classes, replacement ranges, and direction-aware motion
Editor plugin, listener, update, DOM-query, focus, and flush lifecycle
Native input, composition, keyboard, pointer, and clipboard routing
Mapped point/range decorations and widget projection
Function-identity commands, pure specs, handlers, binding, and interception
Changed-region invariant corrections
Declarative menu items, groups, templates, and custom controls
Always-active extension-local style modules

representation.reason: Wordgard.styles installs stable low-precedence extension CSS independently from opt-in themes.

concepts.title: Editor-scoped opt-in themes with unique scope classes

representation.reason: Wordgard.theme has per-editor activation and generated scope identity, unlike always-active extension styles.

concepts.title: Color-scheme selection and root-level style-module publication

representation.reason: Root/frame/shadow-root stylesheet publication and light/dark/auto selection have their own runtime lifecycle.

concepts.title: Editor DOM layout, dynamic attributes, orientation constraints, and CSS variables

representation.reason: DOM attributes and layout constraints are state-derived rendering contracts, not stylesheet-module configuration.

concepts.title: Typed phrase sets, overrides, placeholders, and deferred references
Versioned client queue, acknowledgement, resubmission, and update batching
Host-owned central-server protocol, transform history, transport, and broadcast loop
Single-owner collaboration corrections and remote-history semantics
Bidirectional nested-editor document and selection synchronization

representation.reason: The 101 source concepts contain the primitives but no row owns pad/clip mapping, loop-suppression annotations, parent-position tracking, and child replacement as one nested-editor contract.

concepts.title: Parent-owned history, focus routing, tooltip lifecycle, and flush for a nested editor

representation.reason: No current or planned row judges shared parent undo/redo, Enter/Escape focus transfer, tooltip reuse, and synchronous flush ordering.

concepts.title: Persistent origin attribution mapped through document gaps

representation.reason: The source audit covers generic fields and mappings but not the application contract for preserving provenance across replacements and sessions.

concepts.title: Cached decoration projection of application-owned attribution state

representation.reason: No current or planned row owns the derived state-field to mapped-decoration projection and per-value decoration cache.

concepts.title: Executable example compilation and behavior integrity

representation.reason: The site strips TypeScript with SWC and injects snippets, but has no example typecheck or behavior-test command; this proof obligation is absent from the 101 source concepts and planned splits.

concepts.title: Public reference completeness, links, samples, and search integrity

representation.reason: The reference claims completeness but omits or misnames entrypoints, and no command verifies internal anchors, sample syntax, generated API completeness, or search behavior.

findings.title: The complete-reference claim is false
findings.detail: The reference says it lists every public type/value, names stale wordgard/schema-def instead of wordgard/types, and the generator omits the root wordgard namespace entrypoint.

findings.title: Guide and homepage contain broken internal anchors
findings.detail: The guide links #h-document and #h-schema instead of generated #h-documents and #h-the-schema; the homepage links #tables instead of #table.

findings.title: The system guide contains invalid JavaScript
findings.detail: The multiple-change example contains `from 1` rather than `from: 1`; SWC snippet handling does not validate this Markdown code block.

findings.title: Transaction prose assigns fields to a selection
findings.detail: The guide says transaction fields are stored in a selection, contradicting the transaction API described around it.

findings.title: Static publication rollback is incomplete
findings.detail: After moving the previous destination aside, a failure renaming the staged tree into place cleans the temporary tree but never restores the previous destination.

findings.title: Reference search crashes on punctuation-only queries
findings.detail: String.match returns null, but the search loop iterates `words` without a null guard.

findings.title: Reference-search context extraction uses an ineffective regular expression
findings.detail: The expression only matches context ending in a literal dot followed by a closing bracket, so intended parent context is generally lost.

findings.title: Cross-bundler tree-shaking is explicitly unproved
findings.detail: The FAQ reports Rollup success after a build rewrite and explicitly says handling by other tools is unknown.

findings.title: Homepage compatibility statements are claims, not proof
findings.detail: Accessibility, mobile, bidi, and collaboration statements have no website-owned automated or raw-device evidence and must remain requirements until source tests prove them.
